status: Prospective known-cost sensitivity of already training-selected fixed and expanded controllers. Draft precedes bounded-target parent completion and any selected-controller cost-stress output; freeze parent audits/source/artifact hashes before execution.
question: Q3: with the baseline0.0025 training-selected controller, price, update mode, menu and service decision frozen in each context, how do changed known execution costs affect its whole-path behavior and outcomes?

data.scope: Reused development only; same full120 and five96-train/24-test outer folds. No final returns or fresh holdout.

client.name: C
client.real_observations: Pre-inception100 plus annual endpoints only, with all initial/current/future self-financing fees counted once.

parents.readiness: Both completed parent manifests and independent_audit.json status passed must exist and their outputs/source/input snapshots verify before freezing this experiment. No cost-stress replay while bounded parent/audit is pending.

frozen_decisions.learners: Per context, retain the baseline0.0025 training-selected fixed-family price and expanded-family price/update mode, original risk assignment, executionReview status, three targets and local/global identities. No candidate search, price/mode change, menu/target fitting, admission update, cap update or gamma change at other costs. Existing executionReview remains null at every rate.
frozen_decisions.selection_not_repeated: Do not replay all9/18 training candidates or select using cost outcomes. No nondefault-cost training-risk feasibility claim is made. Gates may react to the known cost while their controller parameters remain fixed.
frozen_decisions.forecast: Each actual decision uses only that context fixed complete120/full or96/outer training joint calendar suffix t:H; actual and all forecast fees use the same declared rate. This studies known costs, not cost misestimation.
frozen_decisions.state: Each original H starts100/all bills/CPI1/peak100/MDD0; current target identity and actual holdings persist. After own first annual MDD-L>1e-12 event, learner/B hold actual quantities from next decision through original H without human response, re-entry or state reset.

comparators.annual_then_pending: Same-cost frozen Balanced reference: mandatory initial restore then annual until own first breach, following-decision pending hold. It retains original risk assignment, independently of a learner executionReview.
comparators.equal_thirds_annual: Exact weights(1/3,1/3,1/3), mandatory allocation then restore EVERY year even after breach; no pending switch, no terminal fee. This is a hypothetical specified research baseline, not a fitted or customer-adapted recommendation. Its target identity index-1 means outside the frozen three-product action menu.
comparators.service_nulls: Original onboarding Review is null for all policies. Each parent learner executionReview remains null for that learner. Specified research comparators are evaluated when original C risk assignment is Balanced; they do not fill missing learner financial outcomes.

base_reproduction.csv: Reproduce parent selected C paths for the risk-price fixed learner and bounded expanded learner, and the bounded fixed copy, including financial metrics/fees/moved/trades/breach/first crossing/target update fields and frozen selection metadata.
base_reproduction.npz: Reproduce every available behavior, financial, state, Q and target field in the corresponding parent selected actual trace. Only legacy annual_prices catalog metadata is excluded: the new trace truthfully records the single actually executed price. Preserve the parent catalog separately in parent_catalog_metadata; never pretend9/18 candidates were rerun.
base_reproduction.numeric_guard: Float comparisons atol2e-10,rtol5e-13 for serialization/roundoff; actions,integer/boolean histories,scenario identities and NULL masks exact. This is audit tolerance, not an action threshold.

outputs.paths: All5rates×4policies×full/OOF120 original C rows=4800, including executionReview nulls. Frozen selected price/mode/status and same-fold identities remain explicit.
outputs.summary: At each rate/policy, original and served counts, conditional mean annualized log growth, median/P10 CAGR, median/P90/fractional CVaR90 MDD, empirical breach/excess, fees/moved/trade and target-update count/fraction. P10/P90 use inverted_cdf, median is standard.
outputs.paired_vs_default: For each policy/rate pair against its OWN base-cost path, keep all120 original full/OOF pairs, common-served financial deltas and coverage; no Review zero imputation.
outputs.policy_contrasts: Same-rate expanded-minus-fixed, each learner-minus-Balanced reference and exactthirds-minus-Balanced reference, reporting common service/NULLs explicitly.
outputs.decision_changes: Whole-trajectory changes versus own base in action, actual-trade flag, pending flag, target identity and target-update flag; report denominator all30 decisions and separate both-prebreach post-inception comparisons. Changed wealth/history means these are not controlled same-state marginal cost effects. Initial allocation does not count as target update; zero moved metadata changes can.
outputs.traces: Actual NPZ cost_label__context__C__policy__field; real behavior/Q from replay, single-price metadata truthful. Frozen controller plan and parent catalog metadata saved separately. No training-grid stress or recalibration outputs.

acceptance: Prospective draft is saved before new market output; exact code/test/parent/source/input hashes and passed audits frozen before execution.
Guarded development IDs and arrays exactly match both parent digests; folds/products/assignments/current labels do not change.
Baseline reproduces all declared parent columns and behavioral NPZ fields, with only catalog metadata exception explicit.
Exactly4800 path rows;120 original full and120 OOF per policy/rate, including all inherited null Review rows.
Same rate is used by actual and all forecast branches; original H30,initial costs,absorbing event and correct pending/comparator conventions preserved.
All rates reported, source/input start=end, no best-cost selection or new risk feasibility certification.
limits: These are hypothetical known-cost sensitivities, not estimated real fee rates or robustness to fee misestimation.
Frozen price/mode/admission/menu stability is imposed, not proof they would be unchanged after recalibration.
Baseline training feasibility is not a certificate at other rates; do not relabel their full/OOF results as newly risk-calibrated.
Do not hide changed crossing, target updates, lost conditional growth or reference differences. No final adoption/winner is selected.

Do not discard or reclassify a nondefault-cost outcome for violating the old empirical cap. That would silently re-screen a frozen selected controller. No pathwise-shield support dominance is claimed for these two priced learners.
independent_Q_subset: Per cost/context/served selected learner, smallest evaluation scenario ID and years2,16,30; active gates independently scalar-fan audit, pending/executionReview skip without replacement. Current hold baseline uses current target; each restore uses chosen target. Audit exact fee/state transitions and inherited Review/denominators for all policies.
